items.exampleEn: You were very brave at the dentist.
The big dog frightened the children.
items.exampleZh: 那隻大狗把孩子們嚇壞了。

items.exampleEn: Driving in the snow can be frightening.
items.exampleZh: 在雪中開車可能很嚇人。
新同學們看起來一臉困惑。

items.exampleEn: My dad tells embarrassing stories about me.
My grandpa wept at my sister's wedding.
items.exampleZh: 我爺爺在我姊姊的婚禮上哭了。

items.exampleEn: The old man looked sadly at the empty house.
items.exampleZh: 老先生傷心地望著那間空房子。

items.exampleEn: People say there is a curse on this old house.
items.exampleZh: 大家說這間老房子被下了詛咒。

items.sentenceEn: I'm confused. Can you explain it again?
items.sentenceZh: 我搞不清楚，你可以再解釋一次嗎？

items.audioEn: Sadly, my favorite cafe closed last month.
items.audioZh: 很遺憾，我最喜歡的咖啡店上個月關了。
items.questionZh: 說話的人最喜歡的咖啡店怎麼了？

items.sentenceEn: That was the most embarrassing day of my life.
items.sentenceZh: 那是我人生中最尷尬的一天。

items.stemEn: The movie was so ____ that I couldn't sleep.
items.stemZh: 那部電影太嚇人了，我都睡不著。

items.stemEn: In the story, an old woman put a ____ on the princess.
items.stemZh: 故事裡，一位老婦人對公主下了詛咒。

items.passageEn: Last Friday, my friends and I watched a frightening movie. In the story, a brave girl tries to break a curse on her village. Some parts confused me, and one scene really frightened my friend Leo. He shouted, and the whole audience turned to look at him. It was so embarrassing! At the end, sadly, the girl had to leave her village, and I had a little weep.
items.passageZh: 上週五，我和朋友們看了一部很嚇人的電影。故事裡，一個勇敢的女孩想解除她村子被下的詛咒。有些地方讓我看不太懂，有一幕真的把我朋友 Leo 嚇壞了。他大叫一聲，全場觀眾都轉頭看他，真是太尷尬了！最後，很遺憾，女孩不得不離開她的村子，我也小哭了一下。

questions.questionZh: Leo 大叫之後發生了什麼事？
options: 他被工作人員請了出去

rubricZh: 可寫例如 a brave boy

items.promptZh: 在公車上睡著真的很丟臉。
referenceEn: Falling asleep on the bus is really embarrassing.
It is really embarrassing to fall asleep on the bus.
rubricZh: 用 embarrassing 表示「令人尷尬的」（不是 embarrassed）
主詞可寫，例如 Falling asleep…、It is…to fall asleep… 等
時態可用現在式或過去式（例如 is、was 等）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 第②關：weep 在 A2 為動詞；例句與閱讀都用名詞 had a little weep（英式口語、少見），不道地也不符該級詞性，建議改 She wept after the sad phone call.；同見 items/14/passageEn 的 I had a little weep。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 執行長裁示：教課綱該級列的詞性。weep 在 lexicon 只列名詞 A2，維持名詞 had a little weep

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第②關：He said a curse when he hit his toe. 搭配不自然，英文會說 He swore / He let out a curse；且單字卡教「咒罵」、mcq q14 考「（下）詛咒」，同課兩義不一致（疑似）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "People say there is a curse on this old house."（原 "He said a curse when he hit his toe."）；一併：同課兩義不一致，單字卡改示範 mcq、閱讀用的「詛咒」義；和 mcq（老婦人對公主下詛咒）、閱讀（解除村子的詛咒）主詞、情境、句型都不同

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：配合例句修改
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "大家說這間老房子被下了詛咒。"（原 "他撞到腳趾時罵了一句髒話。"）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "My grandpa wept at my sister's wedding."（原 "She had a little weep after the sad phone call."）
